$comment: The Question glossary terms backing the Scouting 'Questions' checklist and — more
load-bearing than it looks — SurveyDefinitionReader's scoped candidate lookup, which joins
question display names to their Egeria GUIDs and follows ScopedBy to the Survey Definitions
that answer them. When this batch is missing, that lookup finds nothing and every Survey-tab
load silently falls back to a full instance scan (~20s vs ~0.2s).
Runs after foundations (see ../_folder_order.json): these terms are created inside the
'User Questions' glossary and scoped to funnel-stage/perspective terms defined there.
CANARY CHOICE — two non-obvious constraints, both found empirically on 2026-08-19:
1. Keyed on display_name, NOT qualified_name. Dr.Egeria generates term qualified names as
'<Org>::Term::<Hyphenated-Display-Name>::<version>' (e.g. 'Coco Pharmaceuticals::Term::
Is-this-repository-actively-maintained?::1.0'). That embeds a deployment-specific org
prefix and a version, so it is exactly the wrong thing to hard-code. This is the reverse
of the foundations batch, whose Perspective qualified names ARE author-controlled and
stable — hence _batch.json supporting either key rather than mandating one.
2. NOT the last term in the document, and specifically APOSTROPHE-FREE. Every apostrophe
is doubled on persist ('what's' is stored as 'what''s' — egeria-python
PYEGERIA_ISSUES.md ISSUE-69). The corruption is in the EGERIA SERVER / repository
connector, not in Dr.Egeria or pyegeria: instrumenting the outgoing request shows the
wire payload leaving pyegeria with correct single apostrophes, and reading the element
straight back by GUID returns it doubled. (This entry previously blamed Dr.Egeria's
write path on a theory about a SQLite-backed store in md_processing/v2 — that store
does not exist, `grep -rn sqlite3` finds nothing, and the theory was wrong.)
An affected element can never be found by its real name, so a canary naming one would
mark this batch missing forever and re-heal it on every check — an infinite heal loop,
which for the non-idempotent survey-definition batch means repeated duplicate-link
damage. Two of this document's 41 terms are affected. A server-side fix is in progress;
re-check those two terms once a new Egeria release is available.
The term below is the last apostrophe-free term in the document and is verified present.
Keep it that way: when regenerating, do not point the canary at anything containing an
apostrophe until ISSUE-69 is fixed.
Terms are generated from ../resource_questions.csv (the source of truth) via
scripts/csv_to_dr_egeria_questions.py — edit the CSV and regenerate, don't hand-edit the md.
